structural_reducer_contract.closure_join: join_syntax(children, holes, local_flags): unsupported if any required child/operand unsupported; else ambiguous if any required child/local marker ambiguous; else open if required holes nonempty or any required child open; else closed. Preserve all child holes, with source node ownership. A closed parent implies every required child closed and no required holes; converse only within a supported production.
structural_reducer_contract.constructor: Use one central compose(kind,children,operators,local_holes) for ranges, alternatives, offsets, nth_period and extrema. Union holes by (source owner,expected type,boundary), never discard the left list or overwrite it with right-child syntax. Do not use parser join status as a new supervised label.
structural_reducer_contract.targets: Bind via token-boundary metadata labels and source-local target governor/attachment spans. target=unknown, empty and a known nonempty set are distinct. Question scope is a disclosed fallback hypothesis, not independently observed assignment. A both coordinator belongs to one local target phrase.
structural_reducer_contract.corrections: old->new only when an explicit source relation and compatible component/target scope are present. If both targets known and unequal, leave acts independent. If scope unknown, record unresolved relation rather than copy target. Preserve ordered direction; permutation property applies only to independent acts.
structural_reducer_contract.containment: A child interval may be suppressed only with grammar-production ownership or a declared equivalent parse-alternative relation. Pure containment is a geometric condition, not proof of semantic dependency. Maintain target/clause/quotation/correction evidence and compatibility atoms separately.
structural_reducer_contract.interval_relations: For source-bound [a,b),[c,d): equal; disjoint(b<=c or d<=a); strict contains(a<=c<d<=b); crossing(a<c<b<d or c<a<d<b). Crossing/overlap is not equivalence or permission to join annotations. Use explicit production relation or keep ambiguity.
structural_reducer_contract.projection: Lossless reconstruction proves source accounting only. Typed equivalence also needs operators/holes/targets/roles/polarity/quotation/reference compatibility. Confirmed semantic equivalence remains0; source-bound signature equality alone cannot attest semantics.
